plainTranslation: With Composite Jupiter in the 10th house, the relationship/partnership can bring more opportunities for success, achievement, and status for each of you, whether it’s a personal or business relationship. You can feel that you hit a high point in the relationship, or that the relationship itself is one of the better ones you’ve had. You can find it easier to balance being practical and being optimistic about the relationship, and find it easier to be responsible.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
